    No-Contract Broadband UK. Flex 30. Rolling Monthly.

    Broadband from £34.99/month, with clear term, notice and charge information before acceptance.

    Flex 30 is a 30-day rolling broadband option with no fixed minimum term where eligible. Normal notice is 30 days. Availability, speed information, setup, price and any applicable charges are confirmed before acceptance.

    Availability note: Plans shown are current OCCTA offers and may not all be available at every address.     Under residential contract version 2026.10.1 there is no scheduled CPI-, RPI-, inflation-linked or percentage-based rise on the recurring broadband subscription. Your accepted Contract Summary and Contract Information control the customer-specific terms.

    We cover most of the UK through the Openreach network. Use our postcode checker to confirm availability at your address. If we can't serve you, we'll tell you straight — no messing about.
